## Summary / خلاصه
Describe what changed and why.

## Related issue / Issue مرتبط
Closes #

## Type of change / نوع تغییر
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Gameplay or balance
- [ ] Art / animation / audio
- [ ] Documentation / localization
- [ ] Other

## Testing / آزمایش
Describe the Godot version, device, steps, and results. If not tested, explain why.

## Safety and rights checklist / چک‌لیست امنیت و حقوق
- [ ] No signing keys, secrets, credentials, or private data included.
- [ ] All submitted assets have documented source and compatible permissions.
- [ ] No third-party content is included without authorization.
- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md, LICENSE, and the current CLA status.
